The Discovery Room / Field notes after dark

Track Exchange
Restart

Cooperative cargo exchange, staged relay and held-signal routes

FIELD STUDY
Two-stage relay · 1/48 moves · 0/2 escaped

Bo must first send the iron key to Ada. Ada consumes it to permanently open her gate, retrieves the crank, returns to H, and sends it to Bo. Two separate transfers are required; swapping once cannot solve this route.

Ada cannot cross water W; Bo can. # is wall, G gate, H transfer hatch, E exit, S pressure signal. Transfers require both explorers at their own H.

Route scenario 
Crossed cargo
Two-stage relay
Held signal
Control Ada
Control Bo

Ada at row 4, column 1, carrying nothing. Exit requires gate open. Ada gate closed; signal off.

Selected: Control Ada

Route reset to Two-stage relay.

Field guide
Choose Crossed cargo, Two-stage relay or Held signal. Each route changes the coordination problem, not only the map.
Ada cannot cross water; Bo can. Both must reach their H cells to transfer cargo. Some gates consume a key and stay open; Held signal requires Ada to remain on S while Bo passes.
Reach both E exits with the printed requirements before the move budget runs out. Changing scenario resets the route.

No timer. Every control works with touch or Tab + Enter / Space. Restart returns to a fresh expedition.

Ada cannot cross water; Bo can. Both must reach their H cells to transfer cargo. Some gates consume a key and stay open; Held signal requires Ada to remain on S while Bo passes.
Reach both E exits with the printed requirements before the move budget runs out. Changing scenario resets the route.

No timer. Every control works with touch or Tab + Enter / Space. Restart returns to a fresh expedition.
